purpose: 성인 판타지 RPG 아트 방향 비교용 AI 시안. 실제 Godot 화면이나 사용 가능한 3D 모델이 아니며, 게임 런타임에는 적용하지 않았음.
recommended_direction: A: stylized adventure. Keep adult anatomy and expedition identity, simplify geometry and texture detail for implementation.

files.title: A — 성인 체형의 스타일화된 모험 판타지
files.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: revised art-direction concept board for a small-team 3D fantasy RPG.
Input image: Reference/edit target is Direction A. Preserve its adult expedition fighter identity, full body at left and caravan grassland gameplay view at right, blue-green coat, practical axe, caravan occupation story, river, and bright adventurous mood.
Primary request: Change ONLY the rendering/art complexity to a MUCH MORE STYLIZED, ACHIEVABLE GAME-ART TARGET. The previous version is far too photographically detailed. This version must be unmistakably a hand-painted medium-poly 3D game render, with broad flat color planes and visibly simplified shaped silhouettes, as seen in mature stylized MMORPG game art. Maintain adult anatomy, 7-head proportions, a normal small head, long legs, mature face, articulated arms. Reduce the number of tiny straps and accessory objects; keep only a few large useful bags. Keep readable leather shoulder armor and one simple iron pauldron. Use confident sculpted planes in the face; no visible skin pores, no realistic hair strands, instead a handful of modeled hair clumps. No chibi face, no big eyes, no cute proportions.
Environment material treatment: Draw actual modeled triangular surfaces on shaped rocky outcrops, large simple wood beams, a small number of clear tents and cargo wagons, large brush-painted color gradients, intentionally simplified trees with a few large angular foliage masses. Grass appears in sparse thick hand-painted clumps. Keep soft atmospheric depth and a generous blue sky. No dense individual photoreal grass, no photographic bark, no microtexture, no photogrammetry, no cinematic ray-traced rendering.
Reduce prop and foliage density substantially while keeping the expedition camp inhabited by several adult porters. The overall scene should read like a thoughtfully art-directed attainable indie 3D game, still serious and adventurous, not a children's picture book and not voxel art.
Palette: warm ochre dirt, earthy olive and rich green vegetation, slate blue shadows, warm cream canvas, dusty blue-green coat. Broad readable materials and strong silhouettes, with hand-painted stylized shading.
Text: only the small heading "A / STYLIZED ADVENTURE". No HUD or other text. Landscape 16:9.

files.title: A — 고밀도 초기 연구 시안
files.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: mature fantasy action RPG art-direction concept board, landscape 16:9. This is a proposed art target, not a real screenshot.
Primary request: Redesign the visual identity of an indie 3D expedition RPG away from cute toy-like characters and voxel scenery. Direction A: mature stylized ADVENTURE FANTASY, open grasslands and a working caravan. Inviting daylight, adult gravitas, richly designed shapes.
Composition: A beautifully cohesive professional two-part concept board. Left 30 percent: one large full-body three-quarter front character study on a quiet warm gray backdrop. Right 70 percent: wide third-person gameplay-view environment concept showing this same character from behind at the near edge of a caravan departure camp, looking along a winding road over rolling grassland toward a river crossing and distant mountains. Character and world belong to exactly the same render style. Sparse refined editorial framing.
Character: A visibly adult 30-something expedition fighter, 7-head-tall athletic human proportions, normal-sized head, long articulated arms and legs, angular mature facial structure. Weathered blue-green travel coat over practical brown leather and modest steel protection, worn boots, belt pouches, bedroll, a small warm lantern, a believable long-handled battle axe held naturally. Expressive but restrained, resolute traveler rather than a hulking superhero.
Environment: A compact plausible medieval expedition camp with canvas tents, loaded wooden wagons, a cook's fire, adult porters and a carpenter doing their jobs. Organic rolling slopes, rocky outcrops, wind-swept grass, shaped deciduous trees, a broad curved dirt road and expansive sky. Clear readable foreground and middle distance. One distant ruined stone landmark. Real-world scale relations.
Style/medium: polished hand-painted 3D game concept, strong sculpted silhouettes, simplified cohesive geometry with textured stone, wood grain, coarse fabric and worn steel. Feasible indie art target with controlled detail. Paint strokes and broad material variation, not photograph or cinematic film still. Green and ochre landscape, dusty teal fabric, warm sunlight and cool atmospheric mountains.
Text (verbatim): small elegant upper-left heading "A / ADVENTURE FANTASY". No other text, no HUD.
Constraints: absolutely no chibi, no oversized heads or shoes, no rounded baby faces, no voxel cubes, no Minecraft-like blocks, no plastic toy materials, no excessive giant shoulder armor, no gore, no sexualization, no borrowed game logos. Mature need not mean gray or dark.

files.title: B — 거친 변경지대
files.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: mature fantasy action RPG art-direction concept board, landscape 16:9. Proposed art target, not a real screenshot.
Primary request: Direction B: grounded FRONTIER FANTASY for an expedition RPG with caravans, adult noncombat workers, open highland grassland, and dangerous ruins. Replace cute toy-like characters and voxel scenery with credible human proportions and grounded materials.
Composition: Professional cohesive two-part concept board. Left 30 percent: one large full-body three-quarter front character study against quiet neutral parchment-gray. Right 70 percent: third-person gameplay-view environment, the same traveler seen from behind near a working wagon camp at a river crossing. Curving muddy track runs through rugged windy grassland toward a stone bridge, low hills and a distant ruined watchtower. Show enough lived-in environment to judge actual exploration, not only a portrait. Sparse elegant editorial frame.
Character: A visibly adult 30-something expedition fighter, realistically proportioned 7.5-head human, compact athletic build, natural hands and boots, tired weathered face, short windblown hair. Layered quilted gambeson, dark green wool coat, worn leather harness and restrained iron shoulder protection, trousers, practical boots, tool pouches and bedroll. A modest believable long-handled battle axe. A small warm lantern hangs from the pack. Clothing implies professional labor and travel as much as combat. No heroic bodybuilder proportions.
Environment: Timber and canvas caravan wagons with cargo lashings, sagging tents, adult porters unloading crates, a worker repairing an axle, camp cook smoke, trampled grass, riverbank mud, craggy rocks. Human-scale lived-in frontier camp, not a giant city. Distant rough mountains and layered clouds. Keep main trail clear, people small but visibly adult.
Style/medium: grounded semi-realistic 3D game concept with authored believable materials, restrained fine detail, tactile wool, scarred leather, hammered iron, mud and weathered timber. Crisp and readable, not a DSLR photo. Cooler overcast daylight with patches of sun and small warm camp fires, desaturated moss green, ochre and slate. Mature serious atmosphere and purposeful expedition activity.
Text (verbatim): small elegant upper-left heading "B / FRONTIER FANTASY". No other text, no HUD.
Constraints: no cute cartoon faces, no chibi proportions, no voxel geometry, no generic plastic smooth surfaces, no enormous fantasy pauldrons, no ornamental royal costume, no gore or corpses, no sexualization, no game-brand logos.

files.title: C — 어두운 던전 원정
files.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: mature fantasy action RPG art-direction concept board, landscape 16:9. Proposed art target, not an actual screenshot.
Primary request: Direction C: DARK EXPEDITION FANTASY, a mature adventuring caravan's forward base outside an ancient forest dungeon. Strong adult action RPG mood with visible environment and practical workers. Replace cute toy-like proportions and voxel scenery.
Composition: Cohesive professional two-part concept board. Left 30 percent: a large full-body three-quarter front character design on a dark neutral gray background, clearly lit and easy to inspect. Right 70 percent: a compelling third-person gameplay-view concept of the same traveler from behind in a forest forward camp facing an old monumental stone dungeon gate up a short overgrown path. A clear traversable path, camp at foreground, forest and ruin in middle distance. Sparse elegant editorial framing.
Character: An adult 30-something expedition fighter with a mature angular face, 7.5-head-tall athletic human proportions and natural anatomy. Worn charcoal blue layered travel cloak, quilted and chainmail protection, rough leather belts, limited iron armor, practical calf-high boots, travel pack and small amber lantern. A heavy but plausible long-handled battle axe. Firm grounded stance; no baby-like features, normal head size. Silhouette reads from a gameplay camera.
Environment: A small serious working expedition camp, weathered canvas tents, loaded supply wagons, adult carpenter reinforcing a timber palisade, torch-bearing quartermaster and carriers. Tall naturally branching old trees, damp mossy stone, roots, ferns and a ruined stone dungeon portal with a faint cold mysterious light inside. Terrain remains organic, built structures feel weighty and ancient. Mist separates near camp from the forest; subtle amber firelight gives warm focal points.
Style/medium: sculptural painterly 3D dark fantasy game concept, authored stone and cloth materials, high-contrast readable forms, medium-detail practical indie geometry. Moody blue-green mist and rusty amber firelight, natural daylight still describes all materials. Rich nuanced value separation, not pitch black or a muddy monochrome. Ominous adventure without horror gore.
Text (verbatim): small elegant upper-left heading "C / DARK EXPEDITION". No other text, no HUD.
Constraints: no chibi, no doll-like heads, no block/voxel world, no neon-colored armor, no plastic materials, no skull-covered costume, no gratuitous spikes, no gore, no sexualization, no brand logos.
